audit_scope: Independent read-only comparison completed before authoring this record. Complete result-directory inventories and committed blobs were compared with original worktrees; all historical absolute bindings and raw seal inventories were verified. No native calls, tests, or source changes were performed.

methods.inventory: Python pathlib.rglob('*') over each complete study directory, selecting every file including hidden names, recording relative path, stat size and hashlib.sha256(read_bytes()). Original and integrated inventories were exactly equal.
methods.committed_bytes: /usr/bin/git ls-tree -r --name-only AUDITED_HEAD -- STUDY_PATH; /usr/bin/git show AUDITED_HEAD:FILE compared directly to current working-file bytes for every returned file.
methods.tree_identity: /usr/bin/git rev-parse ORIGINAL_RESULT_COMMIT:STUDY_PATH and /usr/bin/git rev-parse AUDITED_HEAD:STUDY_PATH returned the identical recorded subtree IDs.
methods.seals: For each seal.json, recompute complete parent-directory relative-path byte/SHA inventory, exclude only that seal.json, and compare the complete mapping with the saved inventory.
methods.bindings: Recompute size, SHA256 and resolved path for every original absolute binding; compare all three fields exactly. Both source worktrees remained valid at audit.
methods.ancestry: /usr/bin/git log --reverse --format=%H%x09%s ORIGINAL_BASE..ORIGINAL_RESULT and INTEGRATED_BASE..AUDITED_HEAD; 11 ordered subjects matched.
methods.patch_identity: For each pair, /usr/bin/git diff COMMIT^ COMMIT --binary was supplied as bytes to /usr/bin/git patch-id --stable. All 11 pairs returned equal patch IDs.

limitations: Historical result custody only; not a new native execution or qualification of later source changes.
The audited head predates the decoder successor; this record does not certify successor semantics.
Absolute-path/environment bindings describe the originally executed worktrees, not an implicit rebinding to the integrated checkout.
authoring: This JSON transcribes the completed audit findings and exact tool outputs; no synthetic command output or unperformed check is included.
